The audit framework establishes a formalized read-only inspection protocol that leverages Git-based telemetry to assess GSE correctness. It defines a risk matrix that ranks findings by severity, enabling prioritized remediation. Architectural boundary checks ensure component isolation and prevent cross-layer contamination. These primitives form a dual structure: one for static analysis (audit, boundary) and one for dynamic risk evaluation (matrix). Failure modes include boundary violations leading to unauthorized access, or misclassified risks causing incorrect remediation. The framework enforces a no-edit policy, ensuring audit integrity while enabling probabilistic risk inference through Bayesian telemetry.
